tex_content.html: For $n>2$, consider \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta u=|u|^{p-1}u & \text{in }U,\\ u=0 & \text{on }\partial U, \end{cases} \tag {11} \] in the supercritical range \[ \frac{n+2}{n-2}<p<\infty . \tag {13} \]
